project: Sector Forge 1.2 — maintenance, consistency, and GM control update
scope: Focused 1.2 maintenance release. Fixes the reported data-loss, synchronization, route-recalculation, market-refresh, and diplomacy-editor problems. Adds a persistent faction-turn log. The larger multi-hop supply-chain and full diplomatic/economic simulation redesign remains out of scope.

javascript_syntax.command: node --check applied to all non-minified .js and .cjs files

coverage: deterministic trade-route recalculation without random draws
generated route classification updates after relocation
GM-authored routes and custom metadata survive recalculation and overextension
market recalculation is idempotent and reacts to actual route/control/conflict/corporate changes
manual market price changes remain the new reference price
route-access/stability calculations remain consistent and stale markets are safe
survey rerolls preserve manual and imported orbital objects
World Directory saves update only the edited world and its linked market
imported SWN descriptions remain unchanged during unrelated world edits
route recalculation does not regenerate political blocs
direct diplomacy edits synchronize faction rival references
alliances are respected by faction asset attack selection
faction turn event snapshots persist and preserve referee notes
sector/map generation, all 120 hexes, responsive system survey and map editing
route recalculation preserving GM routes and political blocs
no-op map refresh preserving market prices
World Directory edit, linked market synchronization and unrelated description preservation
custom and imported survey object survival after reroll
direct diplomacy posture/trust/tension editing and quick posture cycling
Alliance synchronization and alliance-safe faction attack behavior
persistent per-turn event archive, editable GM notes and GM/player export privacy
faction turns, influence, market updates and cross-record links
SWN CSV/native JSON import, source preservation and Acheron Rho parent graph
player-safe export privacy and GM JSON/compressed URL round-trip
chromium_end_to_end.environment_note: Chromium in this execution environment blocks navigation to the temporary localhost server. Offline-inline mode exercised the app and synchronous export fallback; the normal same-origin browser Worker startup and browser Worker queue stress could not be exercised here.

export_worker.execution: Node worker_threads using the exact export-worker.js source

limitations: The 1.2 market model now applies deterministic local structural effects from direct operational route access, corporate presence, faction control, and conflict. It is not yet a multi-hop commodity-flow simulation with production, consumption, inventories, shipping capacity, and supply/demand price convergence.
Diplomacy can now be edited directly and Alliance is enforced as a no-attack posture, but broader automatic diplomatic evolution and strategic faction response remain future simulation work.
The Campaign Turn Log archives faction-turn events and GM notes. Existing sector history from before 1.2 cannot be reconstructed beyond the current factionNews snapshot.

The normal same-origin browser Worker path was not exercised because local HTTP navigation is blocked by the Chromium environment policy. The exact worker source passed the separate Node worker-thread verification; the browser fallback and export round-trips passed.
No automated test suite proves the absence of every possible defect or freeze on every browser/device.
